description: Tripo pet bodies for the pets-companions agent (art-collector-3d, Art/TripoArt3D.json). Tripo bodies face +Y, so yaw -90 turns them to actor +X; meshScale brings the raw Tripo bounds to heightCm (scale is never baked). clips is empty when Tripo could not animate the rig: drive the body procedurally (CireCreatureArt precedent).

huntress_sabercat.note: Tripo quadruped animation failed again on 2026-09-25: the Studio's only quadruped preset ('Walk') produces no clip on this rig, and on a fresh neutral-stance quadruped rig (dire wolf) it fails with 'Invalid user input'. There are no idle/run/attack/death presets for quadrupeds. The body still carries the saddle and barding from its mount prompt.
